title: What Is Ethical Hacking?
tagline: Your first mission briefing — understand the rules of engagement.
description: Explore what ethical hacking means, how it differs from malicious hacking, the legal framework around penetration testing, and the career paths it opens up.
author: Cyber Learn Team
learningObjectives: Define ethical hacking in your own words, correctly referencing authorisation, scope, and professional context — not merely 'hacking with permission'
Explain the defining professional difference between a criminal hacker and an ethical hacker, and understand why authorisation is the key distinguishing factor
Describe what written authorisation means and why verbal permission is insufficient in professional security practice
Define the concept of scope in a penetration testing engagement and give one example of an in-scope and one out-of-scope activity
Explain the term VAPT and distinguish a Vulnerability Assessment (identifies weaknesses) from a Penetration Test (validates and proves exploitability)
